seo.title: Ember & Salt
seo.description: Portland woodfire tasting kitchen. Twelve courses, fourteen seats, one oak kiln. Forty miles of ingredients.

footer.ctaText: Seventeen hundred hours, and twenty hundred. The diary opens on the first of the month — regulars write, newcomers telephone.
footer.guestLine: Taken at the door, remembered at the table.
footer.roomNote: Look for the brass flame by the door — three knocks, we answer.
footer.legalNote: Good to know — allergens told ahead are cooked around · smart dress, no ceremony · the whole table takes the tasting.
